yamami.segment

Semantic segmentation module for yamami.

Provides image segmentation using CLIPSeg model from HuggingFace Transformers with text prompts for semantic labeling of sky, cloud, fog, and snow regions.

yamami.segment.segment(profile, prompts=None, resize=512, device='auto', output_dir=None)[source]

Run semantic segmentation on images.

This function segments images using CLIPSeg with text prompts to identify semantic regions like sky, cloud, fog, and snow.

Parameters:

  • profile (DataFrame) – DataFrame with ‘filepath’ column containing image paths.

  • prompts (list[str] | None) – List of text prompts for segmentation. Defaults to [“sky”, “cloud”, “fog”, “snow”].

  • resize (int) – Target size for image resizing before segmentation. Default is 512.

  • device (str) – Device for model inference (“auto”, “cpu”, or “cuda”). Default is “auto”.

  • output_dir (str | None) – Optional directory to save segmentation outputs.

Returns:

A tuple containing:

  • labels (pd.DataFrame): DataFrame with filepath and ratio columns for each prompt (e.g., sky_ratio, cloud_ratio).

  • masks (dict): Dictionary mapping filepath to dict of mask arrays.

Return type:

tuple

Example

>>> profile = pd.DataFrame({"filepath": ["img1.jpg", "img2.jpg"]})
>>> labels, masks = segment(profile)
>>> labels.columns
Index(['filepath', 'sky_ratio', 'cloud_ratio', 'fog_ratio',
       'snow_ratio', 'brightness'])
